issues.description: Missing shebang and docstring header. Code style rule R1 requires conanfile.py to start with '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and a docstring like '"""Conan recipe — nettle 4.0 (Autotools)"""'. The file starts directly with 'import os'.
Unused import 'os'. The 'import os' statement is not referenced anywhere in the main conanfile.py (no os.* calls in any method). It appears to be a leftover from a template.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the 'import os' line since it is not used in this file.

issues.description: Missing 'patch_type' field for all 3 patch entries. Code style rule R12 requires patch_type to be fixed to "portability". None of the 3 patches (0001-config.guess, 0002-config.sub, 0003-configure) declare patch_type.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'patch_type: "portability"' to each patch entry in conandata.yml.

issues.description: patch_description format does not follow the '0001 xxx' convention required by rule R12. Current descriptions ('Recognize HarmonyOS aarch64 in config.guess', 'Add ohos-linux mapping in config.sub', 'Use umask 022 for configure temp dir (hmdfs platform)') do not start with the 4-digit patch number. Rule R12 example: '"0001 build aux config.guess"'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update patch_description to follow the '{patch_number} {description}' format, e.g. '"0001 config.guess HarmonyOS aarch64"', '"0002 config.sub ohos-linux"', '"0003 configure umask 022"'.

issues.description: source.sha256 is empty (sha256: ""). The conandata.yml has the correct sha256 '3addbc00da01846b232fb3bc453538ea5468da43033f21bb345cb1e9073f5094', but the version-level manifest.yaml's source.sha256 field is empty. This is a data quality inconsistency — the manifest should mirror the conandata.yml checksum.
issues.fix_suggestion: Copy the sha256 from conandata.yml: sha256: "3addbc00da01846b232fb3bc453538ea5468da43033f21bb345cb1e9073f5094"

issues.description: patches_applied references old patch names that no longer exist in the repository. The manifest lists '0001-config.guess-harmonyos-support.patch', '0002-config.sub-ohos-linux-support.patch', '0003-configure-umask-fix.patch', but the actual patch files are named '0001-config.guess.patch', '0002-config.sub.patch', '0003-configure.patch' (verified in conandata.yml and the diff stat showing renames). The manifest was not updated after the patch files were renamed.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update patches_applied to reference the actual patch file names: '0001-config.guess.patch', '0002-config.sub.patch', '0003-configure.patch'.

issues.description: configure_options lists '--enable-shared' but conanfile.py defaults to shared=False and explicitly adds '--disable-shared' in generate(). The manifest metadata contradicts the actual recipe configuration.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change '--enable-shared' to '--disable-shared' to match the conanfile.py default_options and generate() logic.

issues.description: Manifest lists 'libxml2/2.15.3' as a build dependency (comment: 'lld链接器依赖'), but conanfile.py only declares 'gmp/6.3.0' in requirements(). If libxml2 is needed for the build, it should be declared in conanfile.py; if it is only a build-system toolchain dependency handled by the profile/environment, it should not be listed as a package dependency in the manifest.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either add libxml2/2.15.3 to conanfile.py requirements() if it is a true runtime/build dependency, or remove it from the manifest's dependencies list if it is handled by the build environment (E064 ld.bfd wrapper).

issues.description: Hardcoded user-specific local paths: 'cc: ~/tmp/wrappers/cc-wrapper' and 'cxx: ~/tmp/wrappers/cxx-wrapper'. These paths are tied to a specific user's home directory and will not resolve on CI workers or other machines. While this is metadata (not used by conanfile.py), committed files should not contain machine-specific paths.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the cc/cxx fields from manifest.yaml, or replace with generic values (e.g., 'clang'/'clang++'). The actual compiler should be determined by the Conan profile.

issues.description: Software-level manifest homepage 'https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/nettle/' differs from conanfile.py homepage 'https://www.lysator.liu.se/~nisse/nettle/'. The conanfile.py value is the official Nettle project homepage (Niels Möller's page at Linköping University); the manifest value is the GNU FTP download directory, which is a source mirror, not a homepage.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the software-level manifest homepage to 'https://www.lysator.liu.se/~nisse/nettle/' to match the conanfile.py.

issues.description: Missing shebang and docstring header. Rule R1 applies to conanfile.py files including test_package/conanfile.py.

Compiler is hardcoded via tc.update_configure_args({"CC": "clang", "CXX": "clang++"}). While update_configure_args is a valid Conan 2.x AutotoolsToolchain method (verified from Conan develop2 source), hardcoding 'clang'/'clang++' overrides the Conan profile's compiler settings. On OHOS cross-compilation, the profile should determine the compiler. This may work if the build environment has clang wrappers in PATH (per E064), but it reduces portability.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider relying on the Conan profile's compiler settings instead of hardcoding. If explicit override is needed, document why (e.g., OHOS platform standard compiler is clang).

issues.description: Patches the generated 'configure' file directly (umask 077→022 fix). While this is a common pattern in Conan autotools recipes, the preferred approach per R6 is to modify configure.ac and regenerate. Patching configure may break if autoconf version changes. The umask fix is simple and unlikely to break, so this is acceptable as a pragmatic workaround.
issues.fix_suggestion: If feasible, create a patch for configure.ac instead and regenerate configure. Otherwise, this is acceptable as-is.

issues.description: url is defined as a list of 4 mirror URLs. Code style rule R13 shows url as a single string. While using a list is valid Conan 2.x syntax for mirror fallback, it deviates from the rule's example format. All URLs are HTTPS and point to authoritative GNU mirrors (TUNA, USTC, Aliyun, GNU FTP) — no R39 violation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using a single official URL (https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/nettle/nettle-4.0.tar.gz) if CI auto-mirrors non-GitHub URLs, or keep the list if mirror fallback is needed for GNU FTP.

summary:
Audit of nettle 4.0 Conan recipe (branch feat/nettle-4.0). Audited 12 nettle 4.0 files: conanfile.py, conandata.yml, manifest.yaml (version+software level), notes.md, 3 patches, test_package (CMakeLists.txt, conanfile.py, test.c, MANIFEST.yml), and the software-level manifest.yaml.

DECEPTION CHECK (P0): No deception detected. (1) test_package/test.c is a genuine test — it calls real nettle APIs (sha256_init/update/digest, aes128_set_encrypt_key/encrypt) and verifies against known NIST/FIPS test vectors (SHA256 of 'abc' = ba7816bf..., AES-128 FIPS-197 vector). Not a stub. (2) No skipped tests or forced pass — test_package/conanfile.py runs the actual binary in test(). (3) conandata.yml sha256 is valid (64 hex chars, not all-zeros/f). (4) No #ifdef __OHOS__ in patches — all patches use POSIX-compatible config.guess/config.sub/umask methods. (5) No pre-compiled binaries. (6) Nettle is not in R40 deep-adaptation categories.

RECIPE CORRECTNESS (P1): No P1 issues. Verified that tc.update_configure_args() IS a valid Conan 2.x AutotoolsToolchain method (confirmed from Conan develop2 source code — it converts configure_args list to dict, updates, converts back). Version '4.0' is upstream version (first adaptation, R37 OK). Conan 2.x API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.gnu). Source URLs are official/authoritative (R39 OK). No os.environ usage (R33 OK). No platform-compat issues (R32 OK — autotools handles platform via patched config.guess/config.sub).

CODE STYLE (P2): 11 issues found. Primary concerns are in manifest.yaml — empty sha256, stale patch names (not updated after rename), inconsistent configure_options (--enable-shared vs conanfile.py --disable-shared), undeclared libxml2 dependency, hardcoded ~/tmp/wrappers paths, and mismatched homepage. conandata.yml missing patch_type and non-standard patch_description format. Both conanfile.py files lack shebang+docstring. Main conanfile.py has unused import os.

SUGGESTIONS (P3): 3 hints — hardcoded compiler values, patching generated configure file, url as list.

VERDICT: PASS. No P0 deception or P1 recipe-correctness blockers. The recipe is functionally correct and the test package provides genuine API coverage. P2 issues are metadata/style inconsistencies that should be cleaned up but do not block merge.
